BL-1336 — Rotation mode is never exported to the process env, so the vitest fork ceiling cannot tell a rotation-router swarm (one live resident) from a full forge (seven live roles) and leaves concurrency on the table
What it solves: ## Findings recorded at mint — every intake claim re-verified, none assumed
Approval context: Nothing here is broken and nothing is at risk - mono-router packs are not throttled today, they just never got recognised as the roomier topology they are. The whole ticket is a missed opportunity to run the unit suite faster while a router pack is live, and the RAM budget stays the real safety cap…
BL-1336 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1336" (or "reject BL-1336 <reason>") to act.
